**Maintainer-directed execution (2026-08-09 ~08:4xZ): `target:v17` added.** The maintainer instructed the spec seat to put both #4829 follow-up halves on the v17 release board and track them together — an executed ruling, not this seat self-producing the label (the `repo:objectui` routing label remains the triage seat's to apply).

Board rationale, for the record: the framework half (PR #6942) is **merged**, so `Blocked-by: #4829` is satisfied. Until this card lands, the objectui banner still keys on `app.hidden` — after the next console bump against a framework ≥ `97b0798` that read goes stale in both directions: the Unpublished banner would show on nav-hidden published apps (e.g. Account, wrongly) and fail to show on `_unpublished` builds (the server withholds those from non-builders, so the main exposure is the builder's own preview losing its watermark). Rides the same v17 console line as #6954; the two halves land in lockstep with the pin/console bumps.

Tracked by the `domain:spec` seat (#6017) in its round reports until claimed by the objectui seat.

Read-only measurement from the `domain:identity` PM seat — **no claim, no label change, no ownership taken.** Recording a gate so the `repo:objectui` seat does not dispatch this card into a wall.

This card's own Sequencing section requires two things. **One has cleared; the other has not.**

✅ **Framework half landed**: PR #6942 merged **2026-08-09T06:32:57Z**, #4829 closed 06:32:59Z.

❌ **objectui's `@objectstack/spec` pin has NOT advanced past that release**, so `_unpublished` does not yet exist in objectui's types. Measured, not inferred:

| Reading | Value |
|:--|:--|
| objectui's pin (root + every package) | `"@objectstack/spec": "^17.0.0-rc.5"` — an **npm version** pin |
| `packages/spec` version on framework `main` | still `17.0.0-rc.5` — **not bumped** by #6942 |
| Where `_unpublished` was added | `packages/spec/src/ui/app.zod.ts`, commit `97b079896` (#6942), **2026-08-09** |
| Unreleased changesets on `main` | **1561** |

So the published `17.0.0-rc.5` predates the key: it was cut before #6942 merged, and no newer version has been published. objectui's range would pick `_unpublished` up as soon as a newer prerelease is published — **but that publish is a maintainer-only action** (`版本发布必须人工`; no agent seat may run `changeset publish` / a release workflow / push a version tag / merge a "chore: version packages" PR). No amount of agent work clears this gate.

**Suggested handling, for whoever owns the routing**: this card is labelled `pm:queue` while its stated precondition is unmet. `pm:blocked` with `Blocked-by:` pointing at the release (or at a release-tracking card) would describe reality; an agent claiming it today can write code but cannot typecheck it against a key its dependency does not export. Not this seat's label to change — flagging only.

**Contrast, for the record**: the sibling **cloud half #6954 has no such gate** — every cloud package uses `"@objectstack/spec": "link:../../../objectstack/packages/spec"`, a workspace link rather than an npm pin, so it consumes `_unpublished` immediately. That half is dispatchable today and this seat has claimed it (stated openly there, and standing down if a `repo:cloud` seat holds it). It is also the urgent half: with the framework gate now reading `_unpublished` and cloud still stamping only `hidden: true`, a materialized-but-unpublished app is visible to normal users on `main` right now.

**os-dev report — issue #6955** · status `done` · draft PR objectstack-ai/objectui#4238

## Spec pickup (STEP 0) — precondition was ALREADY met on `origin/main`

The dispatch expected objectui to pin `^17.0.0-rc.5` with a possibly-stale lockfile, and this PR to carry the bump. Measured otherwise — someone already advanced it:

| Reading | Value |
|---|---|
| Pin at objectui `origin/main` | `^17.0.0-rc.6` in **all 30** workspace manifests (root, `apps/console`, `apps/site`, every `packages/*`) |
| Lockfile at `origin/main` | `version: 17.0.0-rc.6(ai@7.0.56(zod@4.4.3))` for all 30 importers; `pnpm-lock.yaml` packages section carries `@objectstack/spec@17.0.0-rc.6` |
| `pnpm install` in fresh worktree | `git status --porcelain` **empty** — lockfile byte-identical, nothing to ship |
| Installed version | `node_modules/@objectstack/spec/package.json` → `17.0.0-rc.6` |
| `_unpublished` located in types | `node_modules/@objectstack/spec/dist/app.zod-CH7IEmsS.d.ts:650` → `_unpublished: z.ZodOptional(z.ZodBoolean)`; also `dist/index.d.ts:8265` and `:26809` |

So **no lockfile change is in this PR** — correctly, not by omission. `premise_still_valid: true` for the card itself (the banner really did still read `hidden` at `origin/main`); only the dispatch's sequencing sub-premise had expired.

## Per-surface, before → after (file:line at `origin/main`)

| Surface | file:line | Before | After |
|---|---|---|---|
| Banner read point | `packages/app-shell/src/preview/UnpublishedAppBar.tsx:47` | `app.hidden !== true` → bail | **`app._unpublished !== true` → bail** |
| Per-app publish body | `.../UnpublishedAppBar.tsx:62` | `{ ...app, hidden: false }` | **`{ ...app, _unpublished: false }`** |
| Package publish | `preview/usePublishAllDrafts.ts:76`, `views/metadata-admin/PackagesPage.tsx:359`, `views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx:541`, `console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx:2133` | `POST /packages/:id/publish-drafts` | **unchanged** |
| App Switcher | `packages/app-shell/src/layout/AppSwitcher.tsx:38` | filters `hidden` | **unchanged** — ⛔ pinned by new test |
| Launcher list | `packages/app-shell/src/console/AppContent.tsx:177` | filters `hidden` | **unchanged** — ⛔ comment-pinned |
| Home grid | `packages/app-shell/src/console/home/HomePage.tsx:267` | filters `hidden` | **unchanged** — ⛔ comment-pinned |
| Root landing resolver | `apps/console/src/components/RootLandingRedirect.tsx:53` | filters `hidden` | **unchanged** — ⛔ pinned by new test case |

`PUT /meta/app/{name}` has **exactly one** call site repo-wide (the banner), so the direct-publish row is fully covered. No other App-level `hidden` reader exists beyond the four launcher surfaces above — the remaining `hidden` hits are `Field.hidden` / element-level `hidden` (`FormPage.tsx`, `MetadataService.ts`, `metadataConverters.ts`, `SchemaRenderer`), a different key with a different meaning, untouched.

## Wire fields `unhiddenApps` / `unhideError` — decision: **NOT renamed**

1. **Producer still sends the old names.** Framework `origin/main`, `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:419` (`(result as any).unhideError = …`) and `:426` (`(result as any).unhiddenApps = flipped`). The comment at `:337` says the spelling is kept deliberately.
2. **Consumer reads neither.** `git grep 'unhiddenApps\|unhideError'` over all of objectui `origin/main` → **zero hits**.

"Rename in lockstep, or not at all" therefore resolves to **not at all**: renaming the consumer alone would make the client read a field the server never sends, and there is no read point to rename anyway.

## Tests + typecheck (real output)

```
pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/   → Test Files 334 passed (334) | Tests 3123 passed | 1 skipped (3124)
pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/         → Test Files  33 passed  (33) | Tests  346 passed (346)
pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell type-check  → clean
pnpm --filter @object-ui/console   type-check  → clean
pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell lint        → 0 errors (2264 pre-existing warnings)
```

New: `preview/__tests__/UnpublishedAppBar.test.tsx` (component had none), `layout/__tests__/AppSwitcher.publishState.test.tsx`; one ⛔ case added to `RootLandingRedirect.test.ts`.

**Reverse verification, both directions** — the ⛔ half pins a deliberate non-change, so reverting the fix cannot exercise it:

1. Reverted `UnpublishedAppBar.tsx` to `origin/main` → **5 of 8 red**, the predicted set. The 3 that stayed green are true under either reading (unpublished-and-hidden, neither-flag, preview-mode yield) — reported, not papered over.
2. Injected `a._unpublished !== true` into the AppSwitcher filter → **the ⛔ case went red**, other 3 green.

Both taken out with `git checkout` / file copy, never `git stash`.

## Changeset

**Added** — `.changeset/unpublished-banner-reads-unpublished-key-6955.md`, `@object-ui/app-shell: patch`. objectui uses changesets (41 pending) and every recent user-visible fix carries one; the `apps/console` change is test-only and `console` is unpublished.

## Out-of-scope findings

**None filed.** No unrelated defect was tripped over.

## Open questions (non-blocking — status stays `done`)

**The framework's own comment anticipated a lockstep rename that this card did not perform.** `packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts:337` reads: "The rename rides the objectui follow-up card, together." This card *is* that follow-up, and the measured state made the rename impossible to do here alone (server still emits the old names; objectui reads neither). Options: **(A)** leave both names as-is permanently and drop the framework comment's promise — costs nothing, since no consumer reads them and the field is a diagnostic; **(B)** open a framework-side card to rename producer + the `metadata:reloaded` announce that reads `unhiddenApps` at `:444`, with no objectui change needed. **Recommendation: A**, with B filed only if someone wants the vocabulary tidy — the fields are a diagnostic payload with zero readers, so a rename is pure churn against the startup-focus principle. Flagging so the PM can close the loop on that comment rather than leaving it as a dangling promise.

**Contract note for the PM:** the dispatch prompt specified the bare-URL attribution footer; the os-dev standing contract requires the session-URL form in **PR bodies** because the bare form is stripped from the stored body on every later edit. I used the session-URL form in the PR body and the bare form here (comments are unaffected). Surfacing rather than silently picking a side.
